_snapshot: PROPOSED — not yet created in n8n. The engine of the booking-recovery system. Runs every 5 minutes, reads pending rows from the Data Table `booking_recovery`, and decides who is due for E1 (email, ~30 min after abandonment) or S1 (SMS, ~4 h after abandonment). Re-checks HubSpot immediately before every send so a lead who booked in the meantime is never chased — that re-check is the single most important node in this workflow. Renders the merge fields from docs/booking-recovery/MESSAGE_TEMPLATES.md, including the business-day date logic. BEFORE IMPORT: create the Data Table, replace REPLACE_WITH_DATA_TABLE_ID, set the Error Workflow, and confirm the Gmail credential is 'Hello email' (hello@synchrosocial.com). SMS_ENABLED in 'Select Due' is false until Twilio A2P 10DLC is approved AND the iClosed form carries SMS consent language — see TWILIO_RUNBOOK.md. With it false this workflow sends email only, which is a perfectly good standalone system.
name: Sales — Booking Recovery Dispatch

nodes.name: Every 10 Minutes
nodes.notes: 10 min, not 5 — matches the house polling floor used by Workload Reconcile and Calendar Linear Reconcile, and respects the 2026-07-13 n8n execution-burn cut. Follow-up timing is set by follow_up_due_at, so a coarser poll costs at most 10 minutes of latency on a 30-minute delay.
